title: Project Management + Kick-Off Meeting TPM in Germany
description: Day-to-day coordination, budget monitoring, quality control, risk mitigation, and the Kick-Off Transnational Project Meeting (TPM 1) held in Bonn, Germany. Brings together project coordinators, communication specialists, and key youth workers from all 3 partner organisations to establish a shared vision, confirm division of labor, finalize the monitoring plan, and set the training curriculum foundation.
deliverables: Consortium Partnership Agreements & internal communication protocols established
Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) matrix with bi-monthly reporting adopted
Comprehensive Risk Management and Quality Assurance plan finalized
Project Management digital platform setup for timesheets and quarterly financial tracking
targetAudience: Consortium project coordinators, communication specialists, and youth workers from DE, TR, and RO

title: Drone Operation, Photography, and Video Editing Training Course for Youth Workers
description: A 6-day intensive transnational training mobility in Romania bringing together 18 youth workers (6 from Germany, 6 from Türkiye, 6 from Romania). Designed to equip youth workers with advanced digital competencies in drone setup, EASA flight regulations, aerial photography, videography, and post-production video editing to serve as multiplier facilitators in their home communities.
deliverables: 18 certified Youth Workers equipped with drone flight and digital storytelling competencies
Practical flight modules covering drone setup, EASA safety procedures, and drone maintenance
Photography and video editing masterclasses (framing, color grading, sound design, accessible subtitles)
Youthpass certificates issued to all participants recognising non-formal learning achievements
targetAudience: 18 Youth Workers and educators (6 per partner country) who will lead local youth workshops

title: Booklet on Drone Operation, Photography, and Effective Ways to Mitigate Climate Change
leadingOrganisation: Yenilikçi Eğitim Bilim ve Sanat Derneği - IESA (Türkiye)
description: Comprehensive practical handbook created under the leadership of IESA with expert inputs from Empower Plus and Integrational e.V. Covers three main areas: (1) Technical skills in drone operation, safety guidelines, and legal considerations; (2) Photography and video storytelling techniques; (3) Practical climate change mitigation strategies, local impact identification, and real-world case studies. Published under Open Access license with translations into German, Turkish, and Romanian.
deliverables: Open-access digital publication available for free download (>300 downloads target)
Step-by-step drone flight instructions, safety checklists, and maintenance protocols
Translations into German, Turkish, and Romanian to maximize European reach
Methodological guide for youth organisations, formal educators, and climate NGOs
targetAudience: Youth workers, educators, students, environmental NGOs, and young people aged 15-30

title: 3 x Local Youth Workshops (Germany, Türkiye, Romania)
description: One-day practical workshops organized in each partner country, led by the youth workers who completed the Training Course (Activity A2). Engages at least 20 youth participants per country (minimum 60 young people total, aged 15-30, especially those from marginalized, rural, or low-income backgrounds) plus 2 facilitators per country. Each partner organisation co-finances and acquires a dedicated quality drone (€1,000 per partner) for local youth flights.
deliverables: Minimum 60 young people trained across Germany, Türkiye, and Romania (20 per country)
Hands-on drone flight simulation, basic flight controls, and safety protocol practice
Field photography and videography exercises documenting local environmental challenges
Production of raw footage repositories and youth-created short videos or photo stories
targetAudience: Young people aged 15-30, young climate activists, students, and youth facing fewer opportunities

title: Documentary Series and Photo Exhibition on Local Climate Change Impacts and VR Exhibition
description: Production and online dissemination of youth-led visual storytelling: (1) A documentary mini-series comprising at least 6 short films (2–10 minutes each) exploring specific regional climate impacts with drone footage, ground photography, and community interviews; (2) A digital photo exhibition with detailed captions; (3) A 360-degree Virtual Reality (VR) enhanced exhibition hosted on the Artsteps platform with guided tours and background music.
deliverables: At least 6 documentary short films (2–10 min each) with multilingual subtitles
Curated digital photo exhibition capturing local environmental changes across partner countries
Interactive 360° VR exhibition on the Artsteps platform with guided interactive walkthrough
Public screening packages for schools, youth centres, and local community events
targetAudience: European youth, local communities, environmental activists, policymakers, and the general public

title: Project Website: Construction, Dissemination Hub & Running
description: Central digital hub for sharing all project activities, intellectual outputs, and results under Erasmus+ Open Access licensing. The website hosts the downloadable Educational Booklet, the VR enhanced exhibition, the documentary series, news updates, and an interactive Europe consortium map. Managed by Integrational e.V., the website will remain live and accessible for at least 3 years after the project ends. Monitored against target indicators: >3,000 total visits and >300 booklet downloads.
deliverables: Fully responsive, accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA) web platform at https://greenhorizonyou.eu
Central repository for Open Access educational resources, syllabus, and checklists
Interactive 360° VR panorama player and Europe consortium map
Dissemination analytics tracking to monitor visitor engagement and reach targets
targetAudience: Partner organisations, European youth, educators, NGOs, researchers, and international audiences

title: Dissemination Events and Final Transnational Project Meeting (TPM 2)
leadingOrganisation: Yenilikçi Eğitim Bilim ve Sanat Derneği - IESA (Türkiye)
description: Culminating dissemination and project evaluation phase: (1) Final Dissemination Conferences held in Germany, Türkiye, and Romania with at least 20 participants per country (minimum 60 total) to showcase project results, documentary films, and photography; (2) Final Transnational Project Meeting in Türkiye bringing together 6 partner delegates (2 from each country) to evaluate project indicators, prepare the Erasmus+ Final Beneficiary Report, and establish the long-term Sustainability Plan.
deliverables: Final Dissemination Conferences in 3 countries reaching at least 20 participants each (60+ total)
Final Transnational Project Meeting (TPM 2) in Türkiye with 6 partner representatives
Evaluation of project outcomes, lessons learned, and Final Report documentation
Long-term Sustainability Plan ensuring outputs remain active and scalable across Europe
targetAudience: Youth, educators, stakeholders, local authorities, partner delegates, and civil society
